test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following pie charts represent the distribution of candidates who were enrolled for a competitive examination, and the candidates (out of those enrolled) who passed the exam from five different institutes P, Q, R, S and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8d28543e4a65eea999f74b66f0039d3a7062cb946fe3d982e7a49a8d1236f4b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b64afb653459181f5f4e34fd8892d179f61eceebc9b60fcac2979793b10346a3.png] 

The total number of candidates who enrolled in institutes P, R and T together is what percentage more than the number of candidates who passed from institutes P, R and T together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total candidates enrolled in institutes P, R and T = 20% + 12% + 20% = 52%

Total number of candidates enrolled in institutes P, R and T = 52over 100 × 7500 = 3,900

Total candidates passing from P, R and T = 18% + 18% + 16% = 52%

Total number of candidates passing from P, R and T = 52over 100 × 4000 = 2,080

Difference = 3,900 - 2,080 = 1,820

Difference % = 1820over 2080 × 100 = 87.5%

∴ **The answer is 87.5%.**
